in_marathi.name: Deepashree
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Light of Knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Deepashree हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Deepa (light) + Shree (prosperity, wealth) = Deepashree. A name symbolizing the attainment of spiritual and material wealth through knowledge.
